reference_cohort.local: Loopback; >=4 modern CPU cores, 16 GiB RAM; 1280x720 DPR1 fixed fixture; pinned browser/runtime; one interactive session unless concurrency stated.
reference_cohort.remote: Same fixture with declared 50 ms RTT / 10 Mbps link.

protected_tidiness_budgets.reserve_reason: Measured fleet seed reserves one observed unit while successor cleanup earns each stricter budget.

relative_performance_rule: No >5% regression in unaffected metrics on comparable low-noise fixtures without a recorded causal explanation; target relaxation requires operator amendment.
evidence_policy: Owner-produced applicable receipts establish passing outcomes. Unavailable qualification is non-blocking under continuation_policy and retains its explicit unverified disposition. No self-entered pass flags, historical wrappers, skipped cases or simulations may be relabeled as native passes.

continuation_policy.authority: Operator clarification 2026-09-21 local: no Plan Manager plan, no human approval loop, continuous improvement and fresh adversarial investigation; unavailable validation never blocks.
continuation_policy.unavailable_validation: Attempt reasonable authorized diagnosis/remediation, record the unverified disposition and recheck trigger in the progress file, and continue useful work. Do not repeat unchanged failed prerequisites.
continuation_policy.actual_product_defects: Repair actionable in-scope defects revealed by available evidence. A valid failing assertion is not an unavailable check.
continuation_policy.status_policy: Never return blocked. Defer only the unavailable or unauthorized operation, retain uncertainty and continue useful repairs or fresh investigation. An empty known issue list or clean review is not completion.
continuation_policy.claim_limit: Product readiness claims require applicable evidence. Unverified outcomes retain reading=null and in_band=null. Green outcomes and two clean reviews are dated observations, not a finish line.
continuation_policy.stop_condition: Only operator stop/redirection or enforced runtime interruption stops this engagement. At interruption preserve a resumable checkpoint; do not claim achievement or blocked status.

work_model.scope_policy: Necessary BAS-facing owner repairs may extend these paths after recording cause, owner, changed boundary and validation in the progress file; no per-repair approval. Unrelated changes, commercial publishing, new paid access and unauthorized real-account effects remain excluded.

quality_policy.objective: A substantially more reliable, fast, professional, maintainable and production-ready BAS with material net reduction of technical debt and complexity.
quality_policy.evidence: Compare retained baseline and current affected domains, including moved/shared/untracked source. Record complexity, duplicated policy, coupling, ownership and performance; explain eliminated maintenance obligations. Passing the original ratchet alone is insufficient.
quality_policy.replacement_rule: Complete caller conversion and remove obsolete implementations, dead code, temporary adapters and runtime migration paths. Preserve supported behavior and user data; do not delete functionality to reduce counts.
quality_policy.anti_accretion: No wrapper shuffling, unnecessary generic framework, exported debt, weak tests or unexplained abstractions. When justified code changes are exhausted, investigate fresh cases without manufacturing churn.
